en.name: Thai red curry paste
en.summary: Thai red curry paste is pounded fresh aromatics — chilli, lemongrass, galangal, garlic, shallot, shrimp paste — sold in tubs, jars and sachets. Unopened it keeps about 2 years in the cupboard. Once opened it is startlingly short-lived: 5 days in the fridge.
en.pantry: An unopened tub or sachet keeps about 2 years from purchase in a cool, dark cupboard, away from the hob and out of the sun. That long life comes from the salt and the commercial processing, not from the ingredients themselves. Once it is opened, the cupboard is no longer an option at all: this is fresh low-acid produce, often sitting under oil, which is exactly the situation that carries a botulism risk at room temperature.
en.fridge: Refrigerate the moment it is opened, at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, and use within 5 days. That figure catches people out, because a tub of curry paste looks like a condiment and behaves like a bowl of chopped aromatics. Use a clean dry spoon, level the surface, and do not leave the tub on the counter while you cook. Green and yellow curry pastes are made the same way and keep the same way.
en.freezer: There is no freezer timeline for curry paste, but freezing is the obvious answer to a tub with a five-day window. On the day you open it, press the remainder into an ice-cube tray a tablespoon at a time, freeze at −18 °C (0 °F) and bag the cubes. One cube is roughly what a curry for two wants. Frying the paste off before freezing deepens the flavour and takes out some water, and frozen food held at that temperature stays safe indefinitely.
en.thawing: Drop a frozen cube straight into a hot pan with oil or coconut cream; it melts and fries from frozen. Never thaw curry paste at room temperature.
spoilage: Mould on the surface or on paste standing above the oil
Gas, bubbling or a bulging tub — discard without tasting
A fermented or yeasty smell instead of a sharp, fresh, aromatic one
A rancid, crayon-like smell from any oil on top
tips: Freeze the tub in tablespoon cubes on the day you open it.
Fry the paste before freezing for deeper flavour and less water.
Buy small sachets if you cook Thai food only occasionally.
Label the bag — curry paste cubes all look alike after a month.

faq.q: How long does Thai curry paste last once opened?
faq.a: 5 days refrigerated at 4 °C or below. It is fresh pounded aromatics, not a shelf condiment.

faq.q: How long does an unopened tub keep?
faq.a: About 2 years from purchase in a cool dark cupboard.
Yes, and you should. Freeze it in tablespoon cubes at −18 °C on the day you open the tub.

faq.q: Is green curry paste stored the same way?
faq.a: Yes. Green and yellow pastes are made the same way from fresh aromatics and keep to the same timeline.

zh.name: 泰式紅咖哩醬
zh.summary: 泰式紅咖哩醬是把新鮮辛香料舂磨而成——辣椒、香茅、南薑、蒜、紅蔥、蝦醬——以盒裝、罐裝和調理包販售。未開封放櫥櫃大約 2 年。開封後短得驚人：冷藏 5 天。
zh.pantry: 未開封的盒裝或調理包放在陰涼避光的櫥櫃、遠離爐火與日曬，從購買日起算大約 2 年。這麼長的壽命來自鹽和商業加工，而不是食材本身。一旦開封，櫥櫃就完全不是選項：這是新鮮的低酸性食材，又常常浸在油下，正是在室溫下帶有肉毒桿菌風險的情況。
zh.fridge: 開封的當下就要放 4 °C 以下冷藏，並在 5 天內用完。這個數字常讓人措手不及，因為一盒咖哩醬看起來像調味料，實際上的行為卻像一碗切碎的新鮮辛香料。請用乾淨乾燥的湯匙、把表面抹平，做菜時也不要把盒子一直擱在檯面上。綠咖哩和黃咖哩醬的做法相同，保存方式也一樣。
zh.freezer: 咖哩醬沒有冷凍期限，但對一個只有五天窗口的盒裝來說，冷凍就是最明顯的答案。開封當天就把剩下的以一大匙為單位壓進製冰盒，在 −18 °C 凍硬後裝袋。一塊大約就是兩人份咖哩的用量。冷凍前先炒香，風味更深、水分也更少；而食物在這個溫度下安全性可以無限期維持。
zh.thawing: 直接把冷凍醬塊丟進有油或椰漿的熱鍋，它會邊化邊炒香。咖哩醬絕對不要放在室溫解凍。
spoilage: 醬面或露出油面的醬體長霉
產氣、冒泡或盒子鼓起——不要試吃，直接丟掉
聞起來有發酵味或酵母味，而不是新鮮嗆香的氣味
表面的油發出油耗味或蠟筆味
tips: 開封當天就把整盒分成一大匙的小塊冷凍。
冷凍前先炒香，風味更深、水分更少。
偶爾才做泰式料理的話請買小包裝。
袋子要貼標籤——放一個月後，各種咖哩醬塊看起來都一樣。

faq.q: 泰式咖哩醬開封後可以放多久？
faq.a: 放 4 °C 以下冷藏 5 天。它是新鮮舂磨的辛香料，不是常溫調味料。

faq.q: 未開封的咖哩醬可以放多久？
faq.a: 陰涼避光的櫥櫃，從購買日起算大約 2 年。
可以，而且建議這麼做。開封當天就以一大匙為單位在 −18 °C 冷凍。

faq.q: 綠咖哩醬的保存方式一樣嗎？
faq.a: 一樣。綠咖哩和黃咖哩醬同樣以新鮮辛香料製成，保存期限也相同。
